check_description: All locked Stage 4A and supplemental inputs pass SHA-256 validation.
required_treatment: Stop if any locked input differs.

check_description: Stage 4A final gate is PASS_WITH_CAVEAT with no critical failure.
required_treatment: Do not synthesize a failed prior stage.

check_description: Current focal leadership uses only documented 2026 complete denominators.
required_treatment: Do not mix historical methodology into the current snapshot.

check_description: Latest historical focal leadership contains one complete snapshot per eligible category.
required_treatment: Use only the latest complete historical period per category.

check_description: Leadership snapshot rates are explicitly non-market-share selected-category rates.
required_treatment: Never relabel focal-category leadership rate as market share.

check_description: Observed stability synthesis uses only multi-series directly comparable blocks.
required_treatment: Exclude singleton longitudinal blocks.

check_description: Momentum synthesis uses only multi-series directly comparable blocks.
required_treatment: Exclude singleton longitudinal blocks.

check_description: No comparable longitudinal block includes 2026.
required_treatment: Keep methodology clusters separate.

check_description: Persistence preserves unavailable baseline-incumbent opportunities rather than filling them with zero rates.
required_treatment: Do not treat missing incumbent opportunity as zero persistence.

check_description: Persistence synthesis retains the four Stage 4A eligible records.
required_treatment: Do not broaden persistence beyond eligible complete records.

check_description: The Mayora extended structural sensitivity adds exactly one Le Minerale brand-family key.
required_treatment: Keep primary strict-control attribution unchanged.

check_description: Le Minerale sensitivity does not change Mayora structural breadth rank or the structural leader.
required_treatment: Report the extended view only as sensitivity.

check_description: Le Minerale sensitivity observations remain ineligible for quantitative group-performance comparison.
required_treatment: Do not mix context-only Brand Footprint facts into Top Brand analysis.

check_description: Current and latest-historical complete focal leadership use the same category set.
required_treatment: If category sets differ, do not compare aggregate leader counts directly.

check_description: Every focal group has all seven group-level evidence perspectives.
required_treatment: Preserve non-comparable dimensions outside the numeric matrix.

check_description: Rankable dimensions are evaluated independently rather than forced to share one leader.
required_treatment: Report dimension-specific leaders.

check_description: Consumer reach remains non-comparable.
required_treatment: Do not infer CRP from rank, lower bounds, or qualitative facts.

check_description: Portfolio concentration remains ineligible.
required_treatment: Do not create performance HHI.

check_description: Overall-winner defensibility is determined by explicit gates rather than a composite score.
required_treatment: Use dimension-level reporting while blocking gates remain.

check_description: No composite, weighted overall score, or performance HHI is produced.
required_treatment: Keep synthesis dimension-level and non-composite.

check_description: Stage 4B group-level comparative synthesis and sensitivity is complete enough for visualization and findings preparation.
required_treatment: Use dimension-specific evidence and retain the overall-winner-not-defensible conclusion unless later validated evidence resolves the blocking gates.
